name: OASIS
recent: OASIS 于 2026 年 9 月完成 1 供 2 的附加股配售，并附送凭单 C，新股与凭单已于 9 月 14 日上市。同期，执行董事 DATO' SRI TAN OOI HAN 的持股因认购附加股而增加。2026 年 10 月，DATUK WIRA DR. LIM ZHAO QI 被委任为非执行董事。
notable: 完成附加股配售，发行 73,583,679 股附加股及 73,583,679 张免费凭单 C。
委任 DATUK WIRA DR. LIM ZHAO QI 为非执行董事。
risks: 附加股发行可能导致现有股东股权被稀释。
执行董事 DATO' SRI TAN OOI HAN 在公开市场以外通过配售获得股份，其持股比例上升。

recent_en: OASIS completed a 1-for-2 renounceable rights issue with free Warrants C in September 2026, with the new shares and warrants listed on 14 September. Meanwhile, Executive Director DATO' SRI TAN OOI HAN's shareholding increased due to the rights subscription. In October 2026, DATUK WIRA DR. LIM ZHAO QI was appointed as a Non-Executive Director.
notable_en: Completed rights issue with warrants, issuing 73,583,679 Rights Shares and 73,583,679 free Warrants C.
Appointed DATUK WIRA DR. LIM ZHAO QI as Non-Executive Director.
risks_en: The rights issue may dilute existing shareholders' equity interests.
Executive Director DATO' SRI TAN OOI HAN acquired shares via allotment outside open market, increasing his shareholding.
